title: Select Research picker: compact top area on phones
description: On phones the technology picker spent about half the screen above the first card: a Players row, a subtitle, per-card descriptions, a tall Tech Skips block with its own divider, Available and Selected on separate lines, and filter chips that wrapped onto two rows. Now (phone breakpoint only: width up to 720 px, or height up to 500 px) the roster, subtitle and descriptions are hidden, the title, Select Research badge and Close share one row, Tech Skips is one scrolling line, Available and Selected share a line with the primary button directly below, and the filter chips are one sideways-scrolling row (no scrollbar, momentum scroll, the pressed chip is scrolled into view). Desktop is unchanged. Before shots are taken on the commit without the change (TI4_SHOT_PREFIX=before); after shots are regenerated by npm run screenshots -- EO. Synthetic fixtures through a mocked server.

notes.title: Scope
notes.text: Only web/src/components/TechnologyModal.tsx and .css. The picker is not in web2/. The phone breakpoint is the one this modal already used (max-width 720 px and min-height 501 px, or max-height 500 px, which includes landscape phones). Tap targets stay 44 px, so the compact skips line is one 44 px row of pills.

notes.title: Descriptions
notes.text: There is no tap-to-expand for card text, so on phones the description is simply hidden; names, prerequisite badges and Researched-by stay.
